acme_directory_url.description: stir the STI-CA's ACME directory URL; empty means certificates are issued from a CSR by hand

alert_days.description: stir days before a certificate's not_after at which an expiry alert is raised, comma separated

allow_account_keys.description: stir allow a reseller account its own signing key through /v2/accounts/{id}/stir/keys

attest_forwarded.description: stir attestation for a call that arrived from a carrier and goes back out with the original caller id kept; never above the attestation the inbound call itself carried; the forward rule requires the inbound call to have been a verified carrier call, so a leg claiming to be a forward without that is attested by the other rules; passthru carries the inbound call's own Identity header through instead of signing, and only when that call verified

attest_forwarded_when_inbound_failed.description: stir attestation for a forwarded call whose inbound Identity failed verification, capped at C like every forward of a call that did not verify; a forwarded call whose inbound leg carried no verdict at all takes attest_unverified instead

attest_owned_number.description: stir attestation when the caller id is a number assigned to the account

attest_owned_scope.description: stir whether a number assigned to an ancestor account counts as owned: account or tree; tree walks the account's ancestors without the master account, which is every account's ancestor

attest_transit.description: stir attestation for any other call that arrived from a carrier and goes back out

attest_unverified.description: stir attestation for an authenticated customer calling from a number the platform does not know

attest_verified_external_number.description: stir attestation when the caller id is a verified external number of the account; adopted numbers (gather_external_numbers) never count as verified

cid_name_prefix_failed.description: stir prefix put on the caller id name when inbound verification fails

csr_organization.description: stir the organization (O) every new key's CSR names: the legal name of the service provider the certificate is for; a key cannot be created while it is empty unless the request names one

identity_max_age_s.description: stir how old an inbound Identity's iat may be, in seconds

renewal_enabled.description: stir order a new certificate through ACME when the active key is inside the renewal window

renewal_window_days.description: stir days before not_after at which a renewal is ordered

require_date_header.description: stir reject an inbound Identity when the request carries no Date header

sign_anonymous.description: stir sign when privacy hides the caller id; orig.tn is the real number

sign_enabled.description: stir add an Identity header to outbound carrier calls

sign_non_nanp_origin.description: stir sign when the originating number is outside NANP

stipa_api_url.description: stir the STI-PA API base URL, for the trusted CA list, the CRL and SPC tokens

trust_refresh_hours.description: stir how often the trusted CA list and the CRL are refreshed from the STI-PA, in hours; the CRL lives 24 hours, so keep this well below that

trust_upstream_verstat.description: stir take the carrier's own verdict (verstat on P-Asserted-Identity or From, P-Attestation-Indicator, P-Origination-ID) for a call the SBC classified as a carrier call, and verify locally only when the carrier said nothing

verify_enabled.description: stir verify the Identity header of inbound carrier calls

verify_mode.description: stir sync verifies before the callflow starts, within verify_timeout_ms; async starts the callflow and lands the verdict when ready

verify_timeout_ms.description: stir the budget for fetching the signer's certificate on an inbound call, in milliseconds; past it the verdict is No-TN-Validation

x5u_base_url.description: stir the public prefix new keys' certificates are served under, e.g. https://api.example.com/v2/stir/certs; a key cannot be created while it is empty
